description: Frozen 15-question P0 test set; gold labels checked in saved policy text before retrieval or generation results were inspected.

questions.question: Where must GitLab team members log their time away?

gold.quote: All team members must log their time away in Workday.

questions.question: What does GREEN mean in GitLab's data classification?

gold.quote: Data that is publicly shareable, and does not expose GitLab or its customers to any harm or material impact.

questions.reference_answer: Publicly shareable data that does not expose GitLab or its customers to harm or material impact.

questions.question: Does the Anti-Harassment Policy cover contractors as well as employees?

gold.quote: This policy applies to all team members of GitLab, whether contractor or employee, in all locations.

questions.reference_answer: Yes, all team members, contractors and employees, in all locations.

questions.question: I am working in a cafe. Can I leave my work laptop unattended while I get a drink?

gold.quote: Ensure devices are not left unattended in public areas and are locked when not in use.

questions.reference_answer: No. Do not leave devices unattended in public areas; lock them when not in use.

questions.question: A supplier wants to give me a present while we are negotiating its contract. May I accept?

gold.quote: Team members should never solicit gifts or entertainment, accept cash or cash equivalents, or accept gifts during sensitive business processes, such as contract negotiations.

questions.reference_answer: No. Gifts must not be accepted during sensitive business processes such as contract negotiations.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length under GitLab Password Standards?
Within how many days of starting must a new GitLab team member complete compliance training?

gold.quote: All team members are required, as part of their onboarding, to complete compliance training within 30 days of starting at GitLab.

questions.question: What does GSAT stand for and how often is it provided?

gold.quote: GitLab’s handbook-first General Security Awareness Training is provided annually via Right Hand Cybersecurity, GitLab’s third-party provider, and requires participation and completion by all GitLab Team Members and contractors/TSPs.

questions.question: How are passwords classified, and where must a password be stored if storage is required?

gold.quote: Credentials such as passwords, personal access tokens, encryption keys, and session cookies derive their classification from the highest classification of the data they protect.
If a password is required to be stored, it must be stored within an approved password or secrets manager.

questions.reference_answer: Passwords take the highest classification of the data they protect. Required storage must use an approved password or secrets manager.
questions.notes: A complete answer requires evidence from both documents.
